On October 4, 2008, Rémy Daillet-Wiedemann beat the list of Jean-Bernard Castex (also mayor of Blajan) and became president of the Haute-Garonne branch of MoDem1.

On January 19, 2009, he began a month-long cold strike to protest against the relocation of a company, Molex (American), which was abandoning the French employees of Villemur-sur-Tarn (31) 2,3.

Following the regional elections of March 2010, Rémy Daillet-Wiedemann was excluded from the Democratic Movement on the pretext of having recorded debates. The Paris court will ultimately annul the decisions taken against him4.

He is currently the president of the École à la Maison (Home Schooling) association.
